misses.what: status AMBIGUOUS from a false platform conflict: inspector reports 'web' for a kiosk HTML project (README + 1080x1920 viewport) and the resolver flags it against the correct request platform
input = touch only; the repository handles keydown (scanner wedge) and the platform file names a tactile keypad — keyboard/focus findings were the largest part of the audit
screen/components empty for 'identify step', 'keypad', 'name entry'; product 'government' from ADA/508 mentions
audit+accessibility required only touch target / privacy / session / masking concepts; forms_errors, live_status, focus/keyboard were not required so the bundle was 'covered' without them
no concept for focus retention when a screen is re-rendered from a string after each key (the most serious finding)
no on-screen keypad/keyboard pattern and nothing on scanner-wedge + tactile keypad coexistence
inspect_project: surfaces 'elevated' for flat 3-4 px bordered surfaces; spacing 'irregular' although tokens define an 8 px scale; theme unknown for light + high-contrast mode
focus slot = touch-only (mobile) record for an audit whose findings were keyboard focus retention

knowledge_gaps: on-screen keypad / keyboard pattern for kiosks
scanner keyboard-wedge vs tactile keypad input handling

regressions.query: accessibility audit of a kiosk keypad and name entry
regressions.expect: bundle includes a11y-forms-errors, a11y-live-status, a keyboard/focus record and target size + spacing; input includes keyboard when the project handles keydown

regressions.query: inspect an HTML kiosk project (README: kiosk, viewport 1080x1920)
regressions.expect: platform kiosk; no AMBIGUOUS platform conflict; spacing 8 from --space-N tokens; theme light + high-contrast mode

regressions.query: keypad on-screen for date of birth on a kiosk
regressions.expect: a keypad record: key size >= 64, gap >= 16, delete/clear placement, value read-out, persistent format hint

regressions.query: focus lost after re-rendering the screen on every key press
regressions.expect: a rule to re-focus the equivalent control after DOM replacement, not TV focus rules
